metadata.note: Approximate per-serving estimates for typical portions (not lab-tested); recipes, oil use and portion sizes vary, so treat as roughly +/-20-25%. 'Top 500' is a representative selection of popular Indian foods (plus common everyday and international items), not an official ranking. calories_per_100 is kcal per 100 g (or per 100 ml for beverages); protein_per_100 is g per 100 g (null for beverages).
